instruction: Implement routes.user_route(name). Return "/users/" followed by percent-encoded UTF-8 bytes of name: ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, period, underscore, and tilde remain literal; every other byte is % followed by two uppercase hexadecimal digits. Do not encode the /users/ prefix. Empty name returns /users/. Do not normalize Unicode. api_contract.json and core.py are frozen and must remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Only routes.py may change. Standard library only.
